question: Who can register as a voter?
answer: Any Indian citizen who is 18 years or older on a qualifying date (1 January, 1 April, 1 July or 1 October of the year) and is ordinarily resident in the constituency can register as a voter.

question: How do I register as a new voter?
answer: Fill Form 6 online on the Voters' Service Portal (voters.eci.gov.in) or the Voter Helpline App, or submit it to your Booth Level Officer (BLO) or Electoral Registration Officer (ERO). You will receive a reference number to track it.

question: Which documents are needed for Form 6?
answer: A recent passport-size photograph, a proof of age (for example birth certificate, Class 10 marksheet or passport) and a proof of address (for example Aadhaar, passport, bank passbook or a recent utility bill).

question: How do I correct details or change my address on my voter ID?
answer: Use Form 8. It covers correction of entries, shifting of residence, replacement EPIC (voter ID card) and marking as a person with disability. Submit it on voters.eci.gov.in or the Voter Helpline App.

question: How do I delete a name or object to an entry in the electoral roll?
answer: Use Form 7 for objecting to an inclusion or for deletion of a name (for example a deceased or shifted voter).

question: How can an NRI register as a voter?
answer: Indian citizens living abroad who have not acquired another citizenship can register as overseas electors using Form 6A, with the address given in their Indian passport.

question: How do I check if my name is in the electoral roll?
answer: Use 'Search in Electoral Roll' on electoralsearch.eci.gov.in or the Voter Helpline App. You can search by EPIC number, by details, or by mobile number.

question: How do I find my polling station?
answer: Search your name on electoralsearch.eci.gov.in or the Voter Helpline App to see your polling station. It is also printed on the voter information slip given before polling day.

question: How do I download my e-EPIC (digital voter ID)?
answer: Log in to voters.eci.gov.in with the mobile number linked to your EPIC and choose 'E-EPIC Download'. It downloads as a secure PDF.

question: Which ID can I show at the polling booth?
answer: Your EPIC (voter ID card). If you don't have it, you can show one of the alternative photo IDs approved by ECI, such as Aadhaar, passport, driving licence, PAN card, MGNREGA job card, or a bank or post office passbook with photo. Your name must be in the electoral roll.

question: How can I contact the voter helpline?
answer: Call the Voter Helpline 1950 (add your STD code), use the Voter Helpline App, or visit your nearest Voter Facilitation Centre / ERO office.

question: How do I report a violation of the Model Code of Conduct?
answer: Use the cVIGIL app to report Model Code of Conduct or expenditure violations with a photo or video. Complaints are tracked and acted upon by the flying squads.

question: What facilities are available for persons with disabilities and senior citizens?
answer: Persons with disabilities can request facilities through the Saksham-ECI app. Polling stations provide ramps, wheelchairs and assistance. Eligible senior citizens (85+) and persons with benchmark disability can opt for home voting using Form 12D where it is notified.

question: What is NOTA?
answer: NOTA (None of the Above) is an option on the EVM that lets a voter record that they do not wish to vote for any of the candidates.

question: How do I track my Form 6 / Form 8 application?
answer: Send your reference number here (for example REF-2026-10452) to see the status instantly. You can also use 'Track Application Status' on voters.eci.gov.in.

question: When are the next elections?
answer: Election schedules are announced by the Election Commission of India through official press notes on eci.gov.in. This assistant does not have dates for upcoming elections.
